what: Work images are made into curved panel pieces cut from a cylinder of radius 7.7 (width .649rad · height 3.75 · rounded corners) and hung in 14 cells on a 1.5-turn spiral (WebGL, fov 45 · camera 22). Scroll progress through the band is followed with 1-exp(-6dt), and per cell t = i/14 + progress — turns along the spiral and rises .62 per slot gap, fades in and out with sin over the first and last 25% of the slot, and switches to the next picture each time a picture passes. Rolled fast, the panel bends in the wind by that speed, and the panel facing front (-sin u > .55) is the only one that can be pressed

options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Stage pinned to the screen (child, 100vh sticky) — the canvas is laid here. If absent, the element itself
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Images to hang on the spiral, img (several, hidden and only read) — repeats in rotation if there are too few
options.radius · arc · height: Cylinder radius · panel width (rad) · panel height, default 7.7 · .6494 · 3.75
options.follow: Speed of following the scroll (1-exp(-f·dt)), default 6
options.rest: Progress to freeze at under reduced motion, default .4
options.start · end: ScrollTrigger start and end, default top top · bottom bottom
options.fx:pick: Event fired by the img of the front-facing panel when pressed — the consumer passes data-href
options.fx:progress: Fires each time the panel reports progress (detail.value) — when showing ‹View all› at the end

note: The gap height between cells (step) could not be read from the original bundle, so it is a value fitted by eye (guess). The original’s fbm gradient shader background is not included in this part — it is the consumer’s background

from.where: index.html .v-works (original home #works coil — cylinder 7.7 · width .6494 · height 3.75 · 16×64 grid · 14 cells · 1.5 turns · camera −22 · fov 45 · follow 1-exp(-6dt) · wind .5×speed · front plate -sin u>.55·image on .35s)
